\paragraph{Artifact-first export hook.}
Figures and tables remain blocked from VER2 manuscript promotion unless a
canonical \texttt{ArtifactManifest} is present. Required manifest fields
remain owned by \texttt{common.contracts} and are not redefined here:
\texttt{artifact\_id}, \texttt{artifact\_path}, \texttt{owner}, \texttt{implementation\_scope}, \texttt{claim\_tier}, \texttt{production\_status}, \texttt{created\_by}, \texttt{git\_commit}, \texttt{config\_hash}, \texttt{input\_hashes}, \texttt{code\_version}, \texttt{schema\_version}, \texttt{caveats}, \texttt{required\_gates}, \texttt{passed\_gates}, \texttt{failed\_gates}, \texttt{statistics\_definitions}.
